title: TikTok bans account for upcoming Musk documentary
excerpt: TikTok has suspended the social media account for Alex Gibney's upcoming documentary about Elon Musk ahead of its wider release.
body_html:
TikTok has banned the social media account for an upcoming documentary about Elon Musk directed by Alex Gibney. The platform took action just ahead of the film's wider release.

According to reports, the movie's distributor, Bleecker Street, received notice on a Friday afternoon stating that a permanent suspension was imminent. TikTok did not immediately respond to requests for comment regarding the decision.
